import_policy: qemu_plugin_* undefined symbols equal exact_qemu_imports; ordinary libc/GLib imports and DT_NEEDED recorded separately
source_hash_policy: trace_schema_sha256 binds the actual completed schema source bytes. This contract must not contain its own source_contract_sha256. Builder computes actual source7/fixture7 after integration; receipts independently bind both files.
base_discriminator: Only the exact site1 LDR/CBNZ window may bind or conflict B. Weak exact anchors always register immutable opaque callbacks. Before binding or at another B, only increment saturating siteN_unbound_callbacks; no register reads, rows, quota or disable. Cached callbacks remain usable after binding.
translation: Same TB only; each continuous size4 instruction copies exactly4 and matches all bytes. Complete changed known exact PC disables; a short TB is silent. Two declared entry forms may transition. No cross-TB reconstruction, retained handle or per-TB allocation.
base_envelope: Nonzero page-aligned zero-extended low48; checked subtraction and all full-anchor/event/prediction additions through B+0x1af183f.
userdata: Flat64 host; low48 aligned eventPC, low2 site ordinal, bit48 only entry stub. No dereference or register/guest-memory write.
register_reads: Descriptor found independent of handle; NULL x0 valid. Clear backing bytes and length each attempt. bool true plus exact8 for PC/GPR/token/SP; CPSR exact4. Present optional failure rejects row; absent stays unknown. No partial successful row or counter advance.
mode: Only CPSR.M=0 is EL0t. 4/5/8/9/12/13 remain other_aarch64. A32 or reserved rejects with raw CPSR fault; unreadable mode unknown. Preserve raw NZCV.
prediction: Same exact8 x0 read feeds full64 x0_raw and loaded_w0=low32. CBNZ prediction uses low32!=0 only; nonzero B+0x1af1724, zero B+0x1af1838. No NZCV/full64 condition or branch retirement inference.
raw_preservation: Direct parser returns rows/raw_ledger/begin/end. Ledger retains original LF-inclusive raw hex/ascii, SHA256, byte offset/length and ordered canonical pairs, including refusal evidence; no conversion to legacy raw.
close: End close_result unknown; reader requires owned normal wrapper returncode0, unchanged full trace/assets and no scope_observer_host_error diagnostic.
direct_assertion: assert_shutter_gate_trace_v1(raw_log,declaration,expected), where expected follows frozen OPERAND_INTERFACE expected.case/site_rows/minimum_suppressed/discriminator_expected. Compare all required full64 xN, actual CPSR/NZCV, available independent SP/tokens, exact event and entry form, ordered first16 rows per site; bool never substitutes for int.
context_candidates: Enumerate every entry/internal raw-index combination with same B/CPU0/EL0t, both available exact8 tokens equal, x23=entry x0, low32 x22=low32 entry x1, checked x19=x29+0x48; when either SP available require both and checked entrySP-0x50=internalSP=x29. Do not choose nearest or ordinal match. LR match is a separate raw candidate flag.
Main_FLOW: Strict original Main35 formatter supplies numeric B/LF/reported PID/TID only. Full x0..x3 uniquely matching same-run SHUTTER_FLOW final code2070000 is a content candidate. Four-site plugin supplies no Main-to-token bridge.
maximum_claim: raw_context_candidate_match; invocation_pairing unknown; missing callbacks unknown
